_comment: Pinned list-price table for cost accounting. Prices are USD per 1M tokens at the providers' standard (non-cached, non-batch) tier. This table is a measurement input: its source and pin date are sealed into every run artifact (pricing_source / pricing_date), so a cost figure is always traceable to the table that produced it. Update by bumping 'date' and 'source' together — never silently.
source: Pre-launch provisional prices for the A2 adapter models (2026-09-23). Not verified against provider pricing pages — verify every rate before launch. jev-1.13 is 0.0 (explicitly unaccounted): TypeSafe publishes no public Jev pricing. deepseek-v4-pro and grok-4.7 are unverified placeholders retained for table shape
basis: USD per 1M tokens, list price, standard tier (no prompt caching, no batch discount, no long-context surcharge)

jev-1.13._note: No public Jev pricing found as of 2026-09-23; priced at 0.0 (explicitly unaccounted) until TypeSafe publishes list prices. Never invent a rate.
